subject: MAP: Elmwood security gates, evidence runway, and close timeline
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@elmwoodfin.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Sana Patel <sana.p@elmwoodfin.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Elmwood MAP kickoff - security gates and target close

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Elmwood is aligned to move forward but procurement and security want a clear mutual action plan (MAP) that calls out specific security/compliance gates (SOC 2, SIG/CAIQ, DPA redlines, data retention), owners, and a realistic acceptance timeline so we can sign off with the board on Dec 15.

Two quick asks to start:
- Can you share a MAP draft that maps each gate to evidence and an estimated delivery date?
- We need an answer on whether Redwood hosted meets our data residency needs (US-only) and what the remediation path is if we require private deployment.

I attached our MAP template (Elmwood-MAP-template.xlsx) — feel free to populate the security columns.

Goal: have a finalized MAP + contract redline in place by Dec 10 so internal approvals can run. Is that feasible from your side?

Liam
Head of Platform Partnerships
Elmwood Financial

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@elmwoodfin.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Elmwood MAP kickoff - security gates and target close

Hi Liam — appreciate the context and the template. Attached is a draft MAP (20261121-elmwood-map-draft.pdf) and an evidence intake checklist (evidence-checklist.csv) that maps each security gate to what we can provide and typical timelines. High-level summary below and proposed dates if Elmwood wants to aim for a Dec 10/15 signoff.

Proposed MAP highlights (compressed track for Dec 10 signoff):
- SOC 2 report (Type II, most recent): Owner: Neha Kapoor (Redwood) — delivery: we can provide our latest SOC 2 Type II report and control narrative within 48 hours. If Elmwood requires additional control testing or a scoped bridge letter, that may add 5 business days.
- SIG/CAIQ self-assessment + supplemental artifacts: Owner: Olga Petrov / Security team — delivery: populated SIG questionnaire + artifact links in 3 business days; evidence staging link provided.
- DPA redline and execution: Owner: Marcus Lin — timeline: initial redline back to Elmwood by Tue 11/24, legal negotiation window 3–7 business days depending on carveouts. We can fast-track negotiation if Elmwood provides a prioritized list of non-starters.
- Data retention & residency annex: Owner: Olga Petrov / Product — clarify residency requirement (US-only) and retention windows. If US residency is required, Redwood hosted in our US region meets that; for on-prem/VPC we can propose Private deployment estimate (see notes).
- Evidence staging + sample export: Owner: Neha Kapoor — we will provision an evidence bucket (read-only) and a short-lived access token. Evidence packaging (logs, access lists, KMS attestations) estimate: 2 business days after confirmation of scope.

Open questions we need from Elmwood to finalize dates:
1) Confirmation whether the Dec 15 board signoff is firm (we can compress further if you confirm Dec 10 signature target).
2) Any residency or contractual restrictions beyond US-only (e.g., customer-controlled KMS, escrow).
3) A prioritized list of DPA redline items so we can triage the negotiation.

Notes on compressed vs standard timelines: the compressed track assumes Elmwood will accept standard SOC 2 reports + our SIG artifacts and be flexible on a small number of DPA carveouts. If Elmwood requires a fresh SOC 2 audit scope or bespoke control testing, the timeline will move out (typically 4–6 weeks).

Next steps I propose:
- I’ll populate your spreadsheet with the MAP draft and proposed dates this afternoon.
- Marcus will circulate a DPA redline and call out non-starters.
- Neha will prepare an evidence staging plan and a short checklist of items we need from Elmwood (sample accounts, expected traffic volumes, person of contact for access logs).

If that sounds good I’ll mark the MAP draft as v0.1 and request your POC to confirm the residency + priority items.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Senior Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0198

Attachment: 20261121-elmwood-map-draft.pdf (MAP draft)
Attachment: evidence-checklist.csv (evidence intake checklist)

From: Liam O'Connor <liam@elmwoodfin.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Sana Patel <sana.p@elmwoodfin.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 11:08:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Elmwood MAP kickoff - security gates and target close

Thanks Olga — that structure looks good. Quick clarifications:
- Residency: yes, US-only is required. We also have a strong preference for customer-managed keys (KMS) if feasible — can you outline the KMS options (Redwood-managed vs customer-managed) and potential impact on timeline/cost?
- Data retention: our default internal policy is 90 days for conversational logs and 7 years for compliance-related audit artifacts; we may accept shorter retention if supported by a formal attest/archival process.
- DPA: the priority redlines for us are indemnity limits, data processing location clause, and audit rights.

If you can add a short KMS options section to the MAP (even a bulleted pros/cons and whether Private deployment is required for customer KMS), that will help procurement.

We should plan for a quick sync Mon AM to triage any blockers. I’ll have Sana join.

—Liam

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Internal: Elmwood MAP - action items and compressed-track plan

Folks — summarizing internal action items from Olga's draft so we’re aligned before Monday's sync. Quoting Olga's plan below and adding owners/timing.

> Proposed MAP highlights (compressed track for Dec 10 signoff):
> - SOC 2 report (Type II, most recent): Owner: Neha Kapoor (Redwood) — delivery: we can provide our latest SOC 2 Type II report and control narrative within 48 hours.
> - SIG/CAIQ self-assessment + supplemental artifacts: Owner: Olga Petrov / Security team — delivery: populated SIG questionnaire + artifact links in 3 business days; evidence staging link provided.
> - DPA redline and execution: Owner: Marcus Lin — timeline: initial redline back to Elmwood by Tue 11/24, legal negotiation window 3–7 business days depending on carveouts.

Internal asks / clarifications:
1) Neha: please package SOC 2 report + one-paragraph control narrative and upload to the evidence folder by EOD Sun 11/22. Also flag any controls that are not covered in our standard report and estimate extra time if Elmwood asks for expanded evidence.
2) Olga: add a KMS options section to the MAP (hosted KMS with HSM attest, customer-managed keys via cloud KMS, and Private deployment notes). Call out that customer-managed KMS in a hosted mode is possible if Elmwood brings a KMS endpoint and we integrate with it (30–45% longer provisioning).
3) Marcus (me): I’ll produce an initial DPA redline focused on the three priority items Liam called out and mark non-starters. I’ll also add a clause for accelerated evidence access (read-only bucket with link expiry).

Escalation path: if procurement pushes past Dec 10 signoff, escalate to Liam/Olga to set a new firm board signoff date or move to a two-stage agreement (pilot + final commercial).

I’ll circulate the DPA redline by Tue morning and schedule a 30-minute legal handoff with Elmwood.

Thanks,
Marcus
Director, Legal Operations (acting)
